## `create_github_project`

*Available in [Python](#create_github_project-python)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Creates a new CIDA project with GitHub integration.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    create_github_project(
        project_name=None,
        repository_name=None,
        project_root=None,
        template_name=None,
        principal_investigator=None,
        analyst=None,
        data_location=None,
        description=None,
        visibility='internal'
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project_name` (`str | None`) - A name for the new project.
    - `repository_name` (`str | None`) - An optional name for the repository.
    If none is specified, the name of the `project_root` directory will be used.
    - `project_root` (`Path | None`) - The (local) root directory for the project.
    - `template_name` (`str | None`) - The name of a template project to use.
    To see available templates, call list_github_templates().
    - `principal_investigator` (`str | None`) - 
    - `analyst` (`str | list[str] | None`) - 
    - `data_location` (`str | None`) - 
    - `description` (`str | None`) - An optional description for the repository. (default: None)
    - `visibility` (`Literal`) - The visibility for the repository (default: 'internal')

    <h4>Returns `CIDAProject | None`</h4>
